note: One request per construction. predict() never touches the network; an unreachable endpoint leaves the policy exactly equal to the no-hints policy (asserted offline).

spi_xfer_public.comment: receives no joint hints at all; only sequences, which is why the sequence switch exists

defects_found_and_fixed: LLM joint candidates were merged before the gates that read their count: six hints took SPI-master from 7 to 13, disabling M4 ranking and tripping the generated-family gate.  Measured -1 before the fix, +9 after.
EDA_LLM_MODEL was read by the recorder but not the client, so asking for flash silently used v4-pro.
A truncated answer reported status ok with zero hypotheses: completion_tokens == max_tokens (4096) is now reported as truncated.

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: thinking tokens were billed against a budget sized for non-thinking output
defects_found_and_fixed.symptom: EDA_LLM_THINKING=1 returned completion_tokens == 8192 and zero hypotheses on 1 of 3 seeds while still reporting a response
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: the enricher reserves EDA_LLM_THINKING_RESERVE (default 6144) of extra budget when thinking is on, and the audit record now carries the thinking mode so a run is self-describing
defects_found_and_fixed.outcome: truncation gone, but the larger budget then exceeded the timeout; thinking remains off by default on the measurements above

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: LLM joint write lists were re-sorted by address during validation, destroying their semantic order
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: preserve the model's order; deduplicate exact repeats only

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: hold_cycles acted as a pure budget drain
defects_found_and_fixed.symptom: the model asked 256-512 cycles per program; eight programs spent ~3800 of 5000 cycles waiting
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: EDA_LLM_JOINT_MAX_HOLD (default 64), with a clamp count in the audit

zero_regression: 7/7 bundled DUTs bit-identical at 5k local with the enricher wired in and off

thinking_ablation_5k_local.note: Same prompt, same accepted-hypothesis count when the request completes; the difference is entirely about completing. Chain-of-thought tokens are billed against max_tokens, so thinking needs both a larger budget and a longer timeout, and still does not produce more hypotheses.

thinking_on_budget_8192.reading: completion_tokens hit the cap exactly, so seed 260924 got zero hypotheses and therefore zero gain

thinking_on_budget_12288.reading: with headroom the request no longer truncates but exceeds the 45 s timeout on 2 of 3 seeds; the completing seed scored +7, worse than thinking-off's +10 on the same seed

thinking_ablation_5k_local.conclusion: Thinking stays off. It is worse on every axis measured: no more hypotheses (still 6 joint writes), lower and far more variable gain (+2.33 vs +9.33 mean, and +7 vs +10 on the one seed both configurations completed), plus two new silent failure modes - truncation and timeout.
thinking_ablation_5k_local.fail_closed_confirmed_live: The timeout seeds produced covered == the enricher-off baseline exactly (72/120, AUC 0.4967), which is the offline fail-closed property observed on the real endpoint rather than under a fake opener.

round_c_spi_xfer_joint_hints.premise_corrected: The earlier claim 'SPI-xfer receives no joint hints at all' was wrong. It receives 8 accepted joint hypotheses; they simply do not pay off.
round_c_spi_xfer_joint_hints.verified_executable: The exact action sequence the policy queues for protocol_x_baud2_path.spi0_baud2 was replayed by hand and DOES hit its target bin (index 69), plus 63 and 74. So the program is correct and reachable - the failure is not expressiveness.
round_c_spi_xfer_joint_hints.why_no_gain: The model picks the targets the *local compiler* could not compile, not the targets the *run* is missing. Three of its eight targets (spi0_baud2, spi0_last, spi0_dfs8) are already covered by the baseline through other mechanisms, so the programs are largely redundant and still consume joint-program budget.

two_defects_found_and_fixed.defect: validated write lists were re-sorted by register address
two_defects_found_and_fixed.why_it_matters: Order is semantic: a configuration register may only be writable while the block is disabled, so sorting can put the enable before the configuration and make the whole hypothesis ineffective.
two_defects_found_and_fixed.measured: -26 -> -2 bins on the same cached hypotheses

two_defects_found_and_fixed.defect: hold_cycles was a pure idle wait charged to the budget
two_defects_found_and_fixed.why_it_matters: Eight hypotheses asking 256-512 cycles each spent roughly 3800 of 5000 cycles waiting.

prompt_change_reverted.added: a paragraph explaining that observation signals are only sampled while the device runs, plus a description of the executor's wrap (clears enable, applies support config, applies the writes, re-asserts enable, pushes data, waits)
prompt_change_reverted.intent: make observation-gated cross targets reachable for SPI-xfer
prompt_change_reverted.measured_cost: SPI-master 30k local fell from +9 (reverted prompt) to +1 with the paragraph, and the intended beneficiary SPI-xfer stayed at -2
prompt_change_reverted.decision: reverted; the paragraph bought nothing and cost SPI-master

round_c_spi_xfer_joint_hints.draw_sensitivity: The endpoint is not deterministic even at temperature 0 and identical prompts: three draws for SPI-master gave 5k +9/+7 and 30k +1/+9/+13, with different write lists each time. The 5k gain is stable (+7..+9); the 30k gain is not. EDA_LLM_ENRICH_CACHE is what makes any single result reproducible, and it also lets a recorded draw be replayed with no key and no network.
round_c_spi_xfer_joint_hints.conclusion: Do not enable the enricher for SPI-xfer: -2 bins at both budgets, and the targets it picks are not the ones that are missing. The two validator defects are kept (they are correct regardless), the prompt addition is reverted, and the cache stays.
